matrix.observable_outcome: 1 merged PR with 2 associated commits emits exactly 1 ACTIVE PR_CENTERED Event; associated commits attach as evidence without spawning direct-commit Events.
Default-branch commit with confirmed pr_association_status='NONE' emits 1 ACTIVE DIRECT_COMMIT Event.

Commit with pr_association_status='UNKNOWN' is placed in held_items (CLASSIFICATION_HELD, interpreted_as_no_pr=false), excluded from active search/metrics, and rejected with CANNOT_LINK if targeted for merge.
Unmerged commit on non-default branch without PR does not create a DIRECT_COMMIT Event; held as NON_ELIGIBLE_BRANCH pending Snapshot Import filter confirmation.
Referenced ticket attaches strictly as CONTEXT_ONLY metadata on the PR Event, never spawns a standalone Event, and cannot be merged as a peer Event (CANNOT_LINK).

matrix.scenario_area: Shared context-only ticket does not auto-merge PRs
matrix.observable_outcome: Two PRs referencing the same SYN-202 ticket remain 2 separate STANDALONE PR_CENTERED Events (total_countable_events=2, total_composite_events=0).

matrix.scenario_area: Distinction between prohibited auto multi-PR merge and user MANUAL_MERGE
matrix.observable_outcome: Without a MANUAL_MERGE command, multi-PR inputs stay separate (EV-006); only an explicit user MANUAL_MERGE creates a COMPOSITE Event with merge_origin='USER_MANUAL_MERGE' (EV-009).
Initial ingestion preserves 1 PR_CENTERED Event without ungrounded auto-split (EV-007); explicit user SPLIT partitions commits into 2 active SPLIT_CHILD Events (EV-008).
SPLIT supersedes parent Event (searchable_as_top_level=false, counted_in_metrics=false, version=2) and creates 2 active SPLIT_CHILD Events (total_countable_events=2).
MANUAL_MERGE creates 1 ACTIVE COMPOSITE Event (merge_origin='USER_MANUAL_MERGE') and subsumes both member PR Events (total_countable_events=1, total_composite_events=1).

matrix.scenario_area: Composite double-counting prevention in search & metrics
matrix.observable_outcome: Subsumed Composite members have searchable_as_top_level=false and counted_in_metrics=false; queries matching member text return Composite once; total_countable_events never counts both Composite and members.
EXCLUDE transitions target Event to EXCLUDED (version=2), removes it from default search and active counts while keeping sibling Events active and source provenance intact.
DISSOLVE marks Composite DISSOLVED (not searchable/counted) and restores member PR Events to STANDALONE top-level active Events (total_countable_events: 1 -> 2).
MANUAL_MERGE targeting a CONTEXT_ONLY ticket or UNKNOWN-held commit returns REJECTED with CANNOT_LINK and state_mutated=false.
MANUAL_MERGE targeting an already-subsumed Composite member or an EXCLUDED Event returns REJECTED with CANNOT_LINK and state_mutated=false.
Command with stale expected_version=1 against current version=2 returns REJECTED with VERSION_CONFLICT and state_mutated=false.
Cross-workspace MANUAL_MERGE and mismatched-workspace EXCLUDE return REJECTED with WORKSPACE_CONFLICT (OD-010 hiding policy REVIEW_REQUIRED) and state_mutated=false.
Explicitly tagged POST_MVP (B-003); post-INITIAL_BACKFILL PR observation is recorded as DEFERRED_POST_MVP rather than auto-ingested in MVP.
Explicitly tagged POST_MVP (B-003); UNKNOWN commit remains held in MVP and late PR recovery transition is deferred to B-003.
